sources.title: SupraLabs releases reasoning-corpus-4K-5M-v1 dataset with 5M chain-of ...
sources.snippet: SupraLabs released a large reasoning dataset containing 5 million samples, each with user prompts, model thought traces, and final answers in ChatML format. The dataset is designed to train small language models (SLMs) to improve reasoning via chain-of-thought.
